book_vs_repo_gap: This chapter is faithful in span-graph structure and schema constraints, but still omits trigger-argument decoding, external schemas, and richer event timelines.

chapter_notes.counterintuitive_insight: Joint IE gains more from consistency propagation than from stronger local heads. The system should make impossible graphs hard to express.
covered_claims: Chapter 20 now uses span proposals plus entity, relation, event, and time heads.
Relation decoding is schema-constrained instead of unconstrained head-by-head argmax.

failure_modes.note: Schema-constrained decoding suppresses relations between incompatible entity types.

lesson_objectives: Build a span-based IE pipeline with separate entity, relation, event, and time heads.
Enforce schema constraints during relation decoding.
Measure cascade consistency instead of treating local heads independently.

reference_experiments.expected_signal: non-null extraction is harder than overall tagging

reference_experiments.expected_signal: schema constraints should keep illegal relation graphs suppressed
